scope: Case 1: retrospective continuous consumer-profile interpretation; not forecasting or new cluster selection
primary_target: Five-coordinate CLR of mean of twelve monthly normalized Sber published category profiles
secondary_target: Log of annual mean monthly published total spending
estimand: Equal municipality weighted descriptive out-of-fold squared error; contemporaneous annual covariates downloaded in 2026
feature_availability: First publication and revision history unknown; no point-in-time or real-time availability claim
sector_selection: Fixed economic contrasts before model outcomes: agriculture, extraction, manufacturing, utilities, transport, public administration, education, health; no outcome-based selection
sector_denominator: Official annual payroll workers total of covered organizations excluding small businesses; not resident employment or all-economy composition
invalid_share_rule: Retain raw source; missing, nonfinite, negative, nonpositive total, or numerator above total is missing for model; never clip or replace source missingness with zero
primary_comparison: economic_missingness versus economic_sectors on identical rows and folds, both retaining all eight missingness flags
preprocessing: Train-only dummy vocabulary; continuous train median imputation and population SD scaling; train-empty column fixed zero fallback with missingness flag and audit
heldout_regions: Deterministic GroupKFold5; no claim of geographic buffer between adjacent regions
samples: core complete on all8 sector shares if at least100 municipalities and10 regions
uncertainty: 2000 paired region bootstrap resamples of fixed OOF losses, seed13, percentile95%; no model refitting or full pipeline confidence interval
interpretation: Supplementary observed-only partial Pearson correlations after core covariates/type/region; all96 reported (2years x8sectors x6coordinates including log_total), descriptive not causal or independent confirmatory tests
falsification: One deterministic negative control: permute each observed sector column within regions separately in training and validation folds, retaining missing positions, core seed13. No validation donor enters training. Diagnostic only, not permutation p-value
adoption_rule: Recommend sectors as supplementary attributes only if joint numerical increment is positive in both years and both spatial regimes, with geography/missingness/complete-case caveats; do not infer stable discrete economic types
prohibited: census2021 joined to2023/24 without accepted boundaries
source missing or absent industry treated as zero
city prices assigned to unobserved municipalities
new industry data treated as municipal transaction edges
